name: confirm-dialog
purpose: A small confirmation dialog: a title with a close button, one sentence of description, and a Cancel plus a confirm button whose `kind` says how destructive the outcome is (`danger` for a removal or a discard, `primary` for a commit). The unsaved-changes guard uses the same shell; the `actions` slot replaces the two buttons when the guard can also save. Built from `Dialog`, `Panel` parts and `Button`.
useWhen: Before a removal (Remove domain, Delete resource) or a re-run (Clear again).
When someone leaves a form with unsaved changes.
A deletion that needs typed confirmation: put the field in the default slot and set `disabled` until it matches.
avoidWhen: A form of several fields → use `dialog` with your own body.
A settings save that needs no decision → use `save-bar`.
related: dialog` — the overlay it composes; use it directly for anything that is not a yes-or-no decision.
button` — the trigger and the actions.
save-bar` — the unsaved-changes bar this dialog guards.
bestPractices: The confirm label repeats the verb of the title (Remove Domain, Discard changes), never OK or Yes.
kind="danger"` only when the outcome removes or discards something; a commit is `primary`.
Close the dialog from `@confirm` once the action has run; keep it open with `loading` while it runs.
Below `md` the buttons stack full width with the confirm button on top, the same order as `save-bar`.

props.name: title
props.doc: The question or the outcome, as the dialog title.

props.name: description
props.doc: One sentence that says what happens on confirm.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.doc: Label of the confirm button. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Confirm`).

props.name: cancelLabel
props.doc: Label of the cancel button. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Cancel`).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner on the confirm button while the action runs; Cancel, the close button, `Esc` and the overlay stop closing the dialog until it clears.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the confirm button, for a confirmation that needs input first.

events.name: confirm
events.notes: The confirm button was activated; not emitted while `disabled` or `loading`.

events.name: cancel
events.notes: The cancel button was activated; the dialog closes. Not emitted while `loading`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.notes: The control that opens the dialog.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Body content under the description: a field, an alert.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Replaces the Cancel and confirm buttons; receives a close function.

examples.name: Confirm
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Remove domain"
    description="shop.example.com stops answering for this resource once you save. Traffic already pointed at it gets no response."
    confirm-label="Remove Domain"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Remove domain"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>

examples.name: DiscardChanges
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Unsaved changes"
    description="This page has changes you haven't saved. If you leave now, they're discarded."
    cancel-label="Keep editing"
    confirm-label="Discard changes"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Leave page"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>

examples.name: RunAgain
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Clear cached content again?"
    description="This clears the same 2 URLs from the Edge cache again. Each object is fetched from your origin on its next request."
    confirm-label="Clear again"
    kind="primary"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Run again"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>
